transport.title: Malpensa Express
transport.text: Malpensa Express connects Terminal 1 directly with Milano Centrale in about 51 minutes. A one-way ticket costs 15 EUR and can be bought online at trenord.it, in the Trenord app, at ticket machines and from authorised retailers.

sleep.title: Sheraton Milan Malpensa
sleep.text: Sheraton Milan Malpensa Airport Hotel & Conference Centre has direct access to Terminal 1. The hotel has an indoor pool, fitness centre, spa and restaurants; its suites are soundproofed.
